rollout.kill_switch: Set EVAL_RUNTIME_ENABLED=false, remove eval secret and restart; disable student workspace if needed, retaining source/time/ownership guards and records.
rollout.assignment: Sticky per synthetic pilot course and consenting internal participant after independent approvals.
stop_conditions: Any answer/help or draft crosses owner/course or active-exam boundary.
Any fake/cache/replayed/tampered response receives real quality eligibility.
Any evaluation request or corpus write leaves the explicitly validated isolated target.
expand_conditions: Independent engineering/domain/privacy approval of exact combined candidate.
Real-provider and human grading/source/Socratic acceptance meets predeclared thresholds.
Combined013+014+015 staging and live operational gates pass.
rollout.active_exam_policy: Existing sessions remain closable when the workspace is disabled. Results and practice help stay locked while another same-course student exam is active; deadlines use post-lock database time.

rollback.procedure: Commit revert edilir. 0020 yalnız tetikleyici gövdesini daraltır; geri alınması ders silmeyi yeniden kırar, bu yüzden revert edilirse 0009 kusuru geri gelir ve testi kırmızı yanar.
rollback.verification: Revert sonrası test_course_policy_cascade.py kırmızı yanmalı; yanmıyorsa revert eksiktir.

privacy.handling: Synthetic fixtures/evaluation samples only in evidence. Browser unsent drafts are user/course/session scoped sessionStorage, cleared on submit/finish/expiry/logout.
privacy.retention: Versioned aggregate evidence and hashes; acceptance packet has no filled human labels. No credentials or real student content in repository evidence.
